For nominal gold purchases you just need to share your Aadhar Card details with us. However it is mandatory to do also provide your PAN card if:
You have bought gold for more than INR 1.5 Lakhs.
You want to sell gold and withdraw your money.
You want to get gold delivered to your doorstep.

4) How safe is Saving with Aura Gold?
Unlike physical gold, you don't have to worry about theft or expensive locker fees. We store your gold in bank-grade lockers free of cost!
We ensure that gold corresponding to every purchase you make is stored in world-class vaults. All you gold is secured by a SEBI-regulated independent trustee so you can enjoy guaranteed 24K gold

5) What is the minimum buying amount for a Aura Gold? 
 The minimum buying amount for Aura Gold is currently Rs.10.

6) What is the maximum quantity that I can Save in Aura Gold?
As a pilot program, we are open to 1.5L savings per person in a year which does not require you to submit your PAN card.

7) What are the benefits of buying gold with Aura app? 
Some benefits of saving in gold with Aura Gold app include: ease of use, secure storage, and the ability to track your savings and stay on top.

8)Is there a fee for using Aura gold? 
No, Aura Gold doesn't charges any transaction fee for buying and selling gold.

9) How can I contact Aura gold support? 
You can contact Aura gold support through the app or  /  email us at support@auragold.in.

Note: Aura Gold is the rebranded version of Moi Gold. If you were an existing user of Moi Gold, you will seamlessly transition to Aura Gold with all your settings and preferences intact.
